title: Canonical Visual Grammar R0 and Writer R0

before.state: The universal prompt was receiver-first and the Hybrid Receiver contract still allowed an interpretation where every carrier could define a wholly private visual dialect. Tlaloc could search receiver behavior, but there was no explicit canonical WRITE contract from Semantic IR to a versioned Origami aesthetic.

after.state: Origami defines one canonical functional visual aesthetic per profile version, keeps ROSETTA mandatory for self-description and compatibility, adds a deterministic Writer construction-plan runtime, and teaches the Master Prompt both READ and WRITE modes. Visual changes found by Tlaloc become candidate profile revisions and only alter the aesthetic through explicit versioned promotion.

evolution_boundary.origami: validate semantic/visual contract and canonical profile

remaining: connect Writer construction plan to the next canonical carrier renderer revision
run Tlaloc representation-search campaigns for color/numeric/other candidate channels
promote no aesthetic change without cross-model evidence when perception claims are involved
